weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+3. After combat, deals 6 damage to unit.
Effective against flying foes. Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+3. After combat, deals 6 damage to unit.

b.d: If unit’s HP ≤ 25% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.
If unit’s HP ≤ 50% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.
If unit’s HP ≤ 75% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

c.d: At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+2 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+4 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+6 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
